verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping and data-enrichment API, so hosting or running scrapers built with open-source automation libraries is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only prompt- and spec-driven AI agents, a URL-to-text scrape endpoint, and SDKs for its own API. Nothing indicates support for writing or running Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy code.
